evidence.production_implication: Outdoor shoots should prepare for wet conditions and intermittent rain, though the extreme wind and specific afternoon thunderstorm window are unconfirmed.

notes_for_planning: Prepare for intermittent light to moderate rain throughout the day, which may cause wet surfaces and minor delays.
Monitor local IMD nowcasts directly on shoot day as the specific 13:00–17:00 orange alert and high winds (40-50 km/h) are not currently confirmed in the available reports.
Ensure safety measures for any rooftop or outdoor setups, as general dampness and isolated heavy showers remain a risk.
